newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 3.436 billion yuan from 2.407 billion yuan with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Trading was more active than Monday mainly because the short-term financial centers, money brokerages run by the central bank, traded actively, traders said.
The admission last month of a number of foreign banks to the market through the short-term financial centres has also helped trading to became more active in the past few weeks, they said.
Traders said that there was ample money supply on the market at present and that the interbank rates would not move sharply up or down in the short-term.
